citations.claim: At first violating step 79 controller force 677.16 exceeds fmax 5; body speed 3.32 m/s near waypoint
Previous step 78 was within force limit (force 5) with higher speed 9.7 m/s, showing spike at step 79

explanation: High-gain (kp=100) controller with max sensor noise (1.0) commands 677N vs 5N fmax limit. Seeded noise corrupts sensed velocity/position producing huge velocity-error spike that is not clamped to fmax before application/check.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body hovers in the upper-right just left of the green waypoint across steps 76 to 79. It shows almost no displacement with no wall contact, escape, tunneling, or sudden jump visible in the strip.
